articles.title: The SEC wants to let newly public companies raise cash instantly in its biggest rule change in decades
articles.snippet: The agency is proposing its largest overhaul of public listing rules in over 20 years, cutting compliance costs and giving crypto firms a much easier path to raise cash on Wall Street.

articles.title: Wallet cluster earned $2.4M with 98% win rate on Polymarket military bets: Bubblemaps
articles.snippet: Bubblemaps’ investigation found a cluster of nine accounts that generated $2.4 million with a near-perfect win rate on Polymarket contracts tied to major US military operations.

articles.title: Republican lawmakers call for permanent CBDC ban as House vote approaches
articles.snippet: Tom Emmer, the House majority whip, is also advocating for his Anti-CBDC Surveillance State Act, which has passed the House but has yet to pass the Senate.
